newsitem.title: UK: Britain to evacuate nationals from Albania.
newsitem.headline: Britain to evacuate nationals from Albania.

text.p: Britain is planning to evacuate more than 120 British and other nationals from Albania, a spokesman for the Foreign Office said on Thursday.
British citizens have been told to report to the British Embassy in Tirana at 1400 local time bringing passports and minimum luggage with them.

"In view of the further deterioration of the situation in Albania and reports that the airport in Tirana is closed, we are now arranging for evacuation as soon as possible," the Foreign Office said in a statement.

Officials said that some 100 Britons would be involved in the evacuation, which would be military-assisted, along with a small number of Irish and Canadian citizens for whom Britain has consular responsibility.
In a message sent to them, the Foreign Office said: "This is a final warning, and there is no guarantee of any subsequent evacuation being arranged by civil or military means."
Officials said it was still being decided whether the evacuation will be by plane or boat.
The three British diplomats who work at the Tirana embassy will remain in Albania for the time being, they added.

The United States has already ordered 160 of its government employees and their families to leave Albania, where armed rebels are demanding the resignation of President Sali Berisha. It has urged another 2,000 Americans to go.
